purpose: Independent validation and matched comparisons with frozen corrected algorithms
environment: Python 3.10.14; see requirements-tested.txt; CUDA for exact neural replay
MRW_reference_scope: H=0.5; other H only pure fGn or explicitly unvalidated modulation stress
decision_rules: Stop on covariance normalization or deterministic numerical contract failure.
Do not select model, seeds, scales or reported cells using test performance.
Report finite-discretization and long-record discrepancies, not an exact asymptotic equality claim.
Reuse frozen validation thresholds for nonwhite-fGn tests; no threshold retuning.
Three predictions of one sequence are not three independent samples.
Haar methods remain explicit approximations, not complete WTMM/wavelet-leader implementations.
Preserve prior outputs and checkpoints; use a new output directory for every run.
